messages:
jordan: Quick sync — VeloxBank POC asks: secure doc ingestion + retrieval-augmented answers, embeddings index + reranker, and a KYC tool call flow. They want a 6-week pilot. Who can own tech presales & scope alignment?
meera: I can own model-fit checks and the eval harness. Quick Q: do they actually need 64k context or will 32k suffice? Their docs mention long contracts but not mega blobs.
alex: From the presales questionnaire: most docs are chaptered PDFs, typical sessions under 20k tokens but some combined uploads could hit ~40k. Recommend defaulting to 32k, flag optional 64k for dedicated/private. Also they require tool-calling to external KYC API.
tim: Security side: they asked for VPC peering + KMS with HSM support + SOC2 evidence. That likely pushes toward Private deployment for the final phase. Need to confirm whether they require on-prem.
sasha: Pricing thread: VeloxBank asked committed vs PAYG options. For POC propose Hosted with token cap first, then Dedicated trial (reserved) if they want consistent latency. Will prepare ranges.
jordan: Draft success criteria proposal: 1) avg end-to-end latency (retrieval + generate) < 600ms for 95th pctile, 2) retrieval R-Precision >= 0.7 on our eval set, 3) hallucination incidents < 5% on 200-sample spot-check, 4) tool-call success >= 99.5% (or fallback behavior documented). Thoughts?
meera: Those are good. For hallucination metric we should define annotation rules. I'll build a 200-example eval with labeled ground truth and an answer scoring rubric.
alex: Model selection notes: start hosted with a cost-friendly 13B open variant for initial trials, and propose a 32k-quantized 70B or 34B variant for Dedicated/Private if higher fidelity needed. For reranking: use an embedding retriever + lightweight cross-encoder reranker for final top-K. Example config below: 
```yaml
retrieval:
  embed_model: text-embed-3-small
  index: hnsw-compact
  top_k: 100
  reranker: cross-encoder-1
generation:
  model: redwood-13b-ling
  context_window: 32768
  tool_call: external_kyc_v1 (sync)
  fallback: cached_summary
```
tim: Security/blockers: they require BYOK with HSM (customer keys). Private deployment supports BYOK/HSM but procurement takes time. Also they insist on audit logs retained 1 year. Sales: confirm procurement windows.
sasha: On pricing numbers (very rough): Dedicated 8x-A10G baseline for the workload ballpark $30k–$50k/mo depending on commitment and data egress. Hosted trial (13B) for the POC with token cap — estimate ~$3k–$6k for heavy eval runs. Will refine.
jordan: Also need to define the POC success demo: 3 canonical flows (contract Q/A, compliance redaction, KYC lookup with toolcall) passing the metrics. Meera — can you codify prompts and pass/fail thresholds?
meera: Yes. I'll produce prompt templates for: summarization, span extraction, Q/A with sources, and a tool-call canonicalization example. Will include scoring scripts.
alex: Reranker detail: we should test hybrid approach — dense retrieval (embeddings) for recall + lightweight cross-encoder for precision on top 10. For embeddings model pick a medium-size vector model tuned on legal/finance data.
jordan: Timeline suggestion: Week0 (this week) finalize scope + security Q answers by Friday. Week1-2 ingest sample corpora & build index. Week3 run evals + reranker tuning. Week4-5 latency optimization + deployment validation (VPC peering). Week6 demo + acceptance. Can SRE help with peering in week3?
tim: I'll schedule an eng-sre sync in week3 and add the VPC peering checklist to the ticket. Also need their network contact and test CIDR.
sasha: I'll draft the pricing slide and a short cost comparison (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) by EOD Thursday. Also need to know if they want SLA guarantees for the pilot.
jordan: Security questionnaire: I'll attach SOC2 artifacts and our VPC diagram. Meera — tag me when eval harness is up so I can run customer-facing demo prompts.
meera: Putting the eval harness in the repo now, will include 200 labeled items across the flows. Link once pushed.
alex: Sharing initial ingestion & rerank config (internal gist): https://gist.github.com/alex/poc-config123 — includes index parameters and a quick script to generate embeddings in batch.
sasha: Pricing draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood/velox/velox-poc-pricing-draft (internal).
tim: Security checklist doc: TICKET-4578 has the items and required customer artifacts. Added request for test environment details.
jordan: Action items recap: meera -> eval harness + prompts; alex -> ingestion & reranker config + example index; tim -> sec/peering checklist & eng-sre sync; sasha -> pricing slide + committed options; jordan -> security artifacts + customer comms. Ping if you need handoffs. :thumbsup:
sales-bot: Reminder: VeloxBank BA kickoff meeting Tue 10:00am — calendar invite sent to attendees.
meera: Eval harness pushed to internal repo: https://git.internal/redwood/velox-poc-evals (contains README, 200-sample set, scorer).
alex: Config script for ingestion: https://git.internal/redwood/velox/ingest-script (w/ sample CLI).
sasha: Updated pricing slide after quick engineering check, shared link in drive.
tim: Added note: customer must fill network form and provide test certs before peering.
jordan: Great — aim to close scope decisions by Friday so we can start ingestion Monday. Thanks all.
